NATO Summit in Albania Faces Uncertainty Over US Reluctance and Defence Spending

The next NATO summit in Albania is uncertain due to the United States' reluctance and low defence spending. This has led to concerns among allies about the alliance's ability to address security threats. The situation has been further complicated by human rights issues in Turkey, where activists have been arrested ahead of the summit.
